newsitem.title: HUNGARY: NUTRICIA OFFERS TO BUY ALL HAJDUTEJ SHRS.
newsitem.headline: NUTRICIA OFFERS TO BUY ALL HAJDUTEJ SHRS.

text.p: Dutch food company Nutricia International BV offers to buy all shares in Hungarian dairy firm Hajdutej Rt at a price of 1,500 forints ($8.53) per share, Nutricia said on Friday.
Hajdutej, in which Nutricia holds a stake of 96.78 percent, is likely to ask the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) next month to delist it.

"Hajdutej shareholders' extraordinary meeting next month is expected to decide on initiating the delisting of Hajdutej shares from the BSE," Nutricias said in a statement in the BSE's official gazette.
According to BSE rules, a company can be kept on the bourse only if no single investor owns more than 90 percent of its shares.
Nutricia boosted its stake to above 90 percent at the end of last year.
Nutricia offers to purchase all Hajdutej shares, which are still in the hands of other investors, between February 28 and April 14.
